_note: Hand-reviewed admission list for the Intelligence Bar general admin edit (owner ruling 2026-10-12: a general EDIT tool is allowed for a reviewed allow-list of small internal edits only; owner login only; always a confirm card; its own gate). A PUT or PATCH endpoint is in the catalog ONLY when it has a row here. A row says what a person read: the handler and every function the scan followed, end to end. It carries the scan fingerprint it was reviewed against (signals, unresolved callees, the tables written, and a hash of the handler text and of every followed function body and same-file constant), so any edit to that chain drops the endpoint from the regenerated catalog until it is reviewed again. body is the allow-list of fields an edit may carry (type, size, enum); the tool refuses any other field and never drops one. required lists fields that must be present. waive maps one scan signal (an effect_call or credential_field that the deny rules would stop) to the reason a person read it and found it harmless; the hard signals (outside calls, messaging or payment modules, signed or customer links, file responses, deletes, DDL, raw SQL writes, bulk inserts) can never be waived. writes must equal the tables the code writes, and none may be a money, message or queue table. scope: customer (scopeParam is the customer id), visit (scopeParam is a visit id; the tool binds the visit to its customer) or broad. noSend is the line the card shows about what the edit does NOT do. requireState (optional) names a record state the edit requires (the card and the Confirm both refuse any other). The card's record label, the current value of every carded field and the row version come from admin-write-snapshots.js, pinned in the card and re-read at Confirm and after the save. rejected lists candidates a person read and kept out, with the reason; it changes nothing at run time.

reviewed.label: Text message template: name and wording
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-sms-templates.js PUT /:id) with validateTemplateBody, extractTemplatePlaceholders and the keep-list checks it calls: loads the template row, validates the new body (required placeholders, the STOP line on first-contact texts, no double braces), then one UPDATE of sms_templates (body, name, updated_at). is_active and trigger_event_key are left off the allow-list: they switch a text on or off. Re-reviewed 2026-10-30 (#7129): REQUIRED_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDERS gained the two cancellation balance twins ({balance}, {pay_url}); a stricter validator only, same writes and signals. Re-reviewed 2026-11-01 (#7368): REQUIRED_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDERS gained rain_out_customer_pick_v1 ({pick_url}, {pick_by}); a stricter validator only, same writes and signals.
reviewed.reason: Changes the stored wording of one SMS template. The handler runs the same validator the Templates screen runs. No send, queue, schedule or customer lookup is in the chain; the only write is one UPDATE of sms_templates.
reviewed.noSend: Changes template wording only. No text is sent or queued now; later texts of this kind use the new wording.

reviewed.label: Email template: name and description
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-email-templates.js PUT /:key) with normalizeTemplateInput, cleanString and assertOneOf: locks the template row, merges the body onto the stored row (every other column is re-written with its own stored value) and UPDATEs email_templates. Status, mode, send stream, audience, legal class, sender and reply-to addresses and variable lists are left off the allow-list.
reviewed.reason: Renames or re-describes one email template. The other columns are re-saved unchanged by the handler's merge. No send or queue is in the chain; the only write is one UPDATE of email_templates.
reviewed.noSend: Changes the template's name or description only. No email is sent or queued; the template's status, sender and wording are not touched.

reviewed.label: Email template draft: subject, preview text and wording
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-email-templates.js PUT /versions/:id) with EmailTemplates.loadVersion, normalizeBlocks and validationFor: refuses an ACTIVE version (400 'Create a draft before editing an active version'); the row additionally requires status draft at the card and again at Confirm (requireState), so an archived or paused version is refused too; one UPDATE of email_template_versions (subject, preview_text, blocks, text_body, updated_at); then renders a validation report with no send.
reviewed.reason: Edits the wording of a draft email template version. An active (live) version is refused by the handler; publishing a draft is a different endpoint that is not on the list. The only write is one UPDATE of email_template_versions.
reviewed.noSend: Edits a DRAFT version only (the handler refuses an active one). No email is sent or queued, and nothing is published.

reviewed.label: Email template preview data: name and sample values
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-email-templates.js PUT /fixtures/:id) with loadFixtureById, requireJsonObject and cleanString: one transaction, UPDATE of email_template_fixtures (name, payload, updated_at). is_default is left off the allow-list (it clears the other fixtures' default flag).
reviewed.reason: Changes the sample values a template preview renders with. Fixtures are preview data only; nothing reads them at send time. The only writes are UPDATEs of email_template_fixtures.
reviewed.noSend: Changes preview sample data only. No email is sent, queued or rendered for a customer.

reviewed.label: Email automation step: subject and wording
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-automations.js PUT /steps/:id): loads the step, then one UPDATE of automation_steps in which each field falls back to its stored value. Delay, order, enabled, sender and reply-to are left off the allow-list (they change when or from where a step sends).
reviewed.reason: Changes the subject or wording of one step in an email automation. The handler writes only automation_steps. It does not enroll, schedule, send or queue anything.
reviewed.noSend: Changes the step's wording only. No email is sent or queued now; emails that step sends later use the new wording.

reviewed.label: Timesheet entry: times, type, notes and reason
reviewed.reviewed: Handler and timeTracking.adminEditEntry read end to end, with assertEntryMutable, the week locks, resolveDisputedDailyStatuses and recomputeEntryMutationSummaries: refuses an active, voided or APPROVED entry, a day or week already approved; keeps the originals on the first edit; recomputes the day and week summaries (time_entries, time_entry_daily_summary, time_weekly_summary). The summary recompute clears the technician's weekly sign-off column so the week needs re-signing; no signature value is read or returned. No pay rate, pay run, message or outside call is in the chain. Re-read 2026-10-25 (#6705): payrollUnits and PAYROLL_SCALE moved unchanged from time-tracking.js to utils/payroll-units.js; writes, signals and unresolved callees are the same. Re-read 2026-10-25 (GATE_AUTO_LUNCH): the day recompute also stores unpaid_meal_minutes (reads the day's no_lunch) and, with the gate on, the week splits regular and overtime on paid minutes; same three tables, no new call or message. The week recompute first refreshes unpaid_meal_minutes on its non-approved days under the week lock (refreshDailyUnpaidMeals); approved days keep their snapshot. The entry-edit sign-off reset is now the shared resetWeekSignOff helper (same tech_signed_at/tech_signature clear the waiver covers). Re-read 2026-10-25 (GATE_SHIFT_CLOSE_REVIEW, #6726): adminEditEntry now calls autoCloseReviewedBy (same file). When the edit CHANGES the clock-out of a shift the system closed automatically and no one has reviewed yet, it also sets auto_close_reviewed_at and auto_close_reviewed_by on that same time_entries row, which releases that shift's pay-run hold; an unchanged clock-out (the editor resends it on every save) changes nothing. Same three tables, same signals and unresolved callees; no message, no pay run. Re-read 2026-10-26 (GATE_PAYROLL_TIME_OFF, #6865): assertEntryMutable now takes the payroll lock in SHARED mode (payroll-lock.js, pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared; edits do not block each other, a finalize of a pay run waits for them) and refuses with 409 when a finalized payroll_checks row exists for the technician and an affected week (a read of payroll_checks, no write); same three tables written, no message, no pay run, no money. Re-read 2026-10-29 (GATE_PAYROLL_PAY_LINES): assertEntryMutable also asks payroll-paid-line-weeks.js paidLineCoveringWeeks (a read of payroll_pay_lines, no write) and refuses with 409 when a paid pay line of the technician covers an affected week (its earned week, or a span that touches the week), so the hours a paid line priced cannot change until its pay run is voided; same three tables written, same signals and unresolved callees, no message, no pay run, no money.
reviewed.reason: Corrects one technician timesheet entry the way the Time Tracking screen does, with a required reason. An approved entry, day or week is refused by the handler. Only time_entries and the day and week summaries are written.
reviewed.noSend: Changes one time entry and recomputes its day and week totals. Any edit, a notes-only one too, resets the entry to pending approval and clears the technician's signature on the week, so they must sign again (the card says whether the week is signed). No message is sent. An approved day or week is refused. It does not change a pay rate or run payroll. Changing the clock-out of a shift the system closed automatically also marks that shift reviewed, so its pay run line is no longer held.

waive.effect_call:lockPayrollMutationsShared: Takes a shared Postgres advisory lock for the length of the transaction so a pay run finalize and an entry edit wait for each other; it changes no row, sends nothing and moves no money.
waive.credential_field:tech_signature: The summary recompute sets the weekly tech_signature column to null so the week needs a new sign-off; the chain reads no signature value and the bar never returns the response body.

reviewed.label: Customer text and report preferences
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-customers.js PUT /:id/notification-prefs) with adminNotificationPrefsDbUpdates, createDefaultCustomerRows (inserts the default property_preferences and notification_prefs rows only when missing, marketing flags NULL), lockAssignedCustomerEmails (advisory lock keys for the emails in the update; the allow-list carries none) and noteHolderSetNotifyPrimary (stamps caller_choice_at on the customer's recipient_optin row): one transaction, UPDATE of notification_prefs. Nothing is sent. The bar refuses a customer with no saved notification_prefs row: the handler would first seed the default rows (confirmations, reminders, en-route and completed texts, payment confirmations), a far larger change than the card could show. It also refuses appointmentNotifyPrimary (even to its current value) while the customer's recipient_optin row has caller_demoted_at set and caller_choice_at unset, because noteHolderSetNotifyPrimary would then stamp the office's choice (a change in who gets visit texts the card cannot show). billingEmail and billingContactName are left off the allow-list: they change who receives invoices. Re-reviewed 2026-10-30 (Customers audit C12): the transaction now first locks the customers row WHERE deleted_at IS NULL and answers 404 for a missing or archived id before any default row is seeded; writes, signals and unresolved callees are unchanged.
reviewed.reason: Flips one customer's text and report preference flags. The handler only updates notification_prefs; a customer with no saved row is refused by the bar (the handler would seed the defaults first). It sends no confirmation and no text. Marketing flags and the billing recipient are not on the list.
reviewed.noSend: Changes which texts and reports this customer gets later. Nothing is sent now, and no opt-in or opt-out message goes out.

waive.effect_call:lockAssignedCustomerEmails: Takes advisory lock keys for any email columns in the update; the allow-list carries no email field, so it locks nothing. It reads and writes no row and sends nothing.
waive.effect_call:noteHolderSetNotifyPrimary: One UPDATE of recipient_optin.caller_choice_at for the customer when a caller was demoted; it records the choice and sends nothing.

reviewed.label: Appointment note (staff only)
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-dispatch.js PATCH /:serviceId/note) with lockOwnedLiveVisit (technician-visit-scope.js): one transaction, locks the visit row (an admin is unscoped), one UPDATE of scheduled_services (notes, updated_at). The note is capped at 2000 characters by the handler. No status change, reminder, confirmation or text is in the chain.
reviewed.reason: Saves the staff-facing note on one appointment, as the Schedule screen's note box does. The handler writes only scheduled_services.notes and updated_at.
reviewed.noSend: Saves the staff note on one visit. The visit's date, time, status and price are not touched, and no reminder or text is sent.

reviewed.label: Product use per service: note
reviewed.reviewed: Handler read end to end (admin-inventory.js PUT /service-usage/:id): builds an update from the named fields and runs one UPDATE of service_product_usage. The unresolved rateReview.guard and weatherReview.guard entries come from router.use('/:id/label-review', ...) wildcard matching and apply to the label-review paths only, not to this route. Service type, product, amount, unit, per-1000 sq ft rate and primary flag are left off the allow-list: they change stock and cost math.
reviewed.reason: Edits the note on one product-use mapping. The only write is one UPDATE of service_product_usage, and only the notes column is on the allow-list. No price, stock count or catalog row is touched.
reviewed.noSend: Changes the note on one product-use row. No stock count, price or cost changes, and nothing is sent.
